decisions.rationale: v1 ALPHA HARD UNIVERSE BREACH: 0/20 top alpha_vector tickers in K200∪KQ150 union. 2434/2983 tickers outside universe. Root cause: factor_engine_proposal.R never applied universe filter to MI prefilter / IS / Val / OOS panels.

decisions.rationale: v1 used AvgTV20 = frollmean(Size, 20). Size is 시가총액 (market cap), NOT trading value. True 거래대금 = Close × Vol. With Size proxy, 9/20 top fell below 2e8 KRW production threshold, 4/20 below 1e8 KRW.
decisions.remediation_v2: RAWDATA[, TV_daily := Close * Vol]. AvgTV20 := shift(frollmean(TV_daily, 20L, align='right'), 1L) per Ticker (C10 t-1 lag preserved). Threshold 2e8 KRW (production, NOT 5e7 override). Verification: top20_pass_2e8 = 20/20 expected.

decisions.rationale: v1 turnover 722.98% > 600% Hurdle Gate v2.2 hard cap. v1 only added challenge_flag and deferred to Optimizer. v2 implements actual mitigation BEFORE challenge.
decisions.remediation_v2: (a) score_ens_raw → score_ens via 3M EMA (alpha=2/(N+1)=0.5) per-Ticker smoothing applied BEFORE top20 ranking. (b) Universe restriction (median 342→331) reduces ranking volatility. (c) Stronger ML regularization (XGB max_depth 5→4, subsample 0.7→0.6, colsample 0.5→0.4, min_child_weight 10→20, lambda 1→2, alpha 0.1→0.5). Expected: turnover materially below 600%. RF-Turnover challenge_flag retained only if post-EMA still > 600%.
